definition: time_to_report_us = subprocess wall-clock from EXECUTING THE COMPILED BINARY to the detector's report on its stream. The nvcc compile is performed untimed, outside the measured region, in BOTH arms -- see the SYMMETRY FIX note in e5b_one. Both arms carry the same fixed process-startup constant, so the comparison is clean though the absolute is not. choreo-entry arm built with default -rtc; compute-sanitizer arm built with --disable-runtime-check so the sanitizer is the sole detector.
